title: Doctor appointment
tagline: You call a clinic to book an appointment for cold symptoms
goal: Book an appointment at the clinic.

reality_check.source: draft 2026-09-05 — verify with user in phase 2; persona/brief/prep NOT yet reworked against it
common_reasons: stomach ache / feeling unwell (お腹が痛い・体調不良)
chronic follow-up or prescription refill (定期受診・薬の継続)
required_questions: symptoms and since when (症状・いつから)
first visit or not (初めてですか)
insurance card — bring it (健康保険証)
final confirmation repeats the specific date and time
conventions: the insurance card is required at every visit at most clinics, not just the first
medication notebook (お薬手帳) and referral letter (紹介状) are asked about when relevant

persona: あなたは内科クリニックの電話受付です。丁寧に応じ、症状の要点と診察希望の日時を聞き取り、予約を確定してください。相手は日本語を練習中の初級者です。短く丁寧なです/ます体で、一度に一つだけ質問してください。

stages: 挨拶・クリニック名乗り
